title: Daily schedule computed with timezone-aware datetimes only
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag stripping tzinfo from run_at or converting through UTC as suspicious. run_at is a wall-clock time in the named zone, so any tzinfo on the time object itself is meaningless and is dropped before combining with the zone; naive 'after' values are rejected instead of being silently interpreted in the host's local zone; and the candidate is compared in local time (strictly after, so an exact hit rolls to tomorrow) before a single conversion to UTC at the end.
